My favorite Grok Bot is Geek 🎬 It's my after-work buddy for horror, 80s/90s cult classics, anime and new releases. It learns your taste on day one and keeps a note of everything you've watched, so the picks keep getting better. Try it: https://t.co/GggRK5SaKm
